desc: First-time lines (Glossary, docs/UI_FIRST15.md 4): a word a new player meets on a screen before anything explains it, keyed by the word as shown, and its one line. The line shows under the word for the whole session it is first seen in, then never again. Keep each line short: the drop map's legend gives it about 34 characters.

lines.Mastery: Goals played as this Hunter: each one done gives a new look.
lines.Glider: What you glide on after a jump. Looks only: they all fly the same.
lines.Boss lair: A boss: beat it for the best loot
lines.Rare Boki: A rare wild Boki you can catch
lines.Item cache: A chest with good gear beside it
